simple.meaning: עוֹלֵל (ʻôwlêl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a suckling.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H5768. olel or olal עוֺלָל עוֺלֵל, noun masculine Lam 2:19 child ; — absolute עוֺלֵל 1Sam 15:3 +, עוֺלָל Jer 6:11 ; 9:20 ; usually plural עוֺלְלִים Psa 8:3 , עֹלְלִים Job 3:16 , עוֺלָלִים Lam 4:4 ; Joel 2:16 ; construct עֹלְלֵי Lam 2:20 ; suffix עֹלָלַיִךְ Psa 137:9 , עֹלָלֶיהָ Micah 2:9 +, עֹלְלֵיהֶם 2Kin 8:2 +, etc.; — child Micah 2:9 ; Lam 2:19-20 , 4:4 ; + יוֺנֵק (sometimes distinguished from men and women), 1Sam 15:3 ; 22:19 ; Psa 8:3 ; Jer 44:7 ; Lam 2:11 ; Joel 2:16 , || בַּחוּרִים Jer 6:11 ; 9:20 ; || בָּנִים Psa 17:14 (heirs of father); dashed in pieces ( רטשׁ ) by foe 2Kin 8:12 ; Hosea 14:1 ; Nahum 3:10 ; Isa 13:16 , compare Psa 137:9 ( נִמֵּץ ); taken captive Lam 1:5 ; stillborn Job 3:16 .
